source.title: Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1908, p. 3 ("For Armagh Rural Council": nominations; "a" = against direct labour, "d l" = direct labour)
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; "no contest", no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 27 May 1908; "there were only six contests". Ballyards (Andrew Davidson, George Brown, Thomas Quinn, senr., nominated) is not in the results; the Irish News says the Nationalists gained a seat there, but the members returned were not found, so it is not filed. The nomination list marks candidates "a" (against direct labour) or "d l" (direct labour); these are not party labels and are not filed as such. Returned unopposed.
